home.title: OpenBridge Rule Toolkit
home.intro: OpenBridge helps families find out which benefits they may get. You know the rules. These tools help you check them and tell us what to fix, with no code.
home.drafts: The rules in OpenBridge are drafts. Experts like you are still checking them.
home.private: Nothing you type here is sent anywhere. Your work stays on this computer until you download a file.
home.sources: Every rule value needs an official source and the date it was published.
home.sendHeading: How to send us your files
home.sendIssue: On the OpenBridge GitHub page, open a new issue with the "Eligibility rule correction" form. Drag your file into one of the text boxes to attach it.
home.sendEmail: Or email the file to openbridge@starlingtek.com.
home.sendAfter: A maintainer adds your change to the rules. Then an expert checks it before it is used.

review.title: Review a state's rules
review.description: See each rule value for a state next to its source. Mark each one as right, wrong, or not sure. Then download a report.

propose.title: Propose a rule change
propose.description: Tell us a value that should change, with the official source. You get a file a maintainer can apply.

check.title: Check a test case
check.description: Open a test case file. See if the current rules give the results it expects.

snap.bbce: Uses broad-based categorical eligibility (looser income and asset tests)
snap.assetLimitElderlyDisabledCents: Asset limit for homes with an older or disabled person

medicaid.parentCaretakerLimitPct: Income limit for parents and caretakers
medicaid.childTierLimitPct: Income limit for children ages {{minAge}} to {{maxAge}}

liheap.categoricalIfSnap: People who get SNAP qualify on income

tanf.baseMonthlyLimitCents: Monthly income limit for the first person
tanf.perAdditionalPersonCents: Amount added to the limit for each other person

review.intro: Pick a state. For each value, open its source and check that the number matches. Your choices stay on this computer.
review.stateStatus: These rules are {{status}}. Last checked on {{date}}.
review.reviewerHint: This goes only into the report you download. We do not keep it.
review.reviewerRole: Your role, for example caseworker or legal aid attorney
review.finishHelp: Download the report, or copy its text. Then send it to us. You can do this even if you have not checked every value.

report.title: OpenBridge rule review: {{state}}
report.footer: Made with the OpenBridge Rule Toolkit. To fix a value, use Propose a rule change, or open an "Eligibility rule correction" issue.

propose.intro: Pick a state, then the value that should change. Enter the new value and the official source that shows it.

amountLabel.pct: New percent of the poverty line

amountHint.pct: Enter a number, for example 130 for 130% of the poverty line.

choice.notUsed: Not used (this test does not apply)

changeError.fieldRequired: Choose the rule value you want to change.
changeError.pctInvalid: Enter a number with no letters, for example 130.
changeError.centsInvalid: Enter a dollar amount, for example 2,750 or 2750.50.
changeError.valueInvalid: This value cannot be used here. Check the number.
changeError.duplicate: You already picked this value in another change. Use one change per value.
changeError.sameAsCurrent: This is the same as what the rules say now. Enter the new value.

propose.addChange: Add another change from the same source
propose.sourceHelp: This source must show every change above. For a different source, make a second proposal.
propose.sourceNameHint: For example, Ohio SNAP Policy Manual, section 4.2.
propose.sourceDateHint: Use the date printed on the source.

sourceName.required: Enter the name of the source.

url.required: Enter the web address of the source.
url.notHttps: Enter a full web address that starts with https://

publishedDate.required: Enter the date the source was published.

propose.explanationHint: In your own words. For example, where in the source the number is.

explanationError.required: Tell us why this should change.

propose.notReady: When every part above is filled in, you can download your proposal.
propose.fixErrors: Some parts need a fix. Look for the notes in red above.
propose.checkFailed: Something in this proposal does not match the current rules. Pick the state again and start over.
propose.nextStep: Next, open an "Eligibility rule correction" issue on GitHub. Paste the issue text and attach the file. You can also email both to openbridge@starlingtek.com. A maintainer applies the file, and an expert reviews the change.

check.intro: Open a test case file. It is a made-up household and the results it should get. You can save one from the OpenBridge test-case page, or find them in the data/states folder on GitHub.
check.dateNote: Test cases are checked as if today were {{date}}.
check.fileHint: A .json file. It stays on this computer.

error.notJson: We could not read this file. Choose a test case file that ends in .json.
error.wrongShape: This file is not a test case. Choose a file saved from the test-case page.
error.unknownState: This test case is for a state the toolkit does not have rules for yet.
error.engineFailed: We could not check this test case. Try saving it again from the test-case page.
error.unreadable: We could not open this file. Try again.

check.allPass: All {{count}} checks pass with the current {{state}} rules.
check.someMismatch: {{failed}} of {{total}} checks do not match the current {{state}} rules.
check.mismatchHelp: A mismatch means the rules or the test case may be wrong. Look at the math below. If the rules are wrong, propose a rule change.
